acceptance: Exports with no caller are removed and listed in a breaking-change changelog entry.
Plan capture is bounded by the run deadline.
Product code and UAT use one process-group kill helper.
description:
## Problem
`benchbox/utils/timeout_manager.py` exports `TimeoutManager`, `get_timeout_manager` and a `timeout` context helper with no caller in `benchbox`; its `run_with_timeout` is used only by plan capture (benchbox/platforms/base/result_capture.py) and abandons a running thread. `ResourceLimitsConfig.default_operation_timeout` and `enforce_timeouts` (benchbox/utils/resource_limits.py) have no caller. Four process-group kill helpers exist (utils/heavy_watchdog.py, utils/resource_limits.py, tests/uat/timeouts.py, scripts/run_version_matrix.py, plus scripts/remote_review.py).

## Owner decision
"remove the ones with no caller, move plan capture onto the new deadline, and record the removal in the changelog as a breaking change to `benchbox.utils`." No new CI check. Source: owner's answer in the choice dialog, 2026-11-20.

## Change
Re-verify each name has no caller on current develop (benchbox, tests, scripts, docs, examples) with the language server's references, and list the evidence. Remove the unused names and their exports and tests. Plan capture keeps its own `plan_capture_timeout_seconds` setting and its 30-second value (not in scope of the defaults decision: it bounds an EXPLAIN, after measurement) but is bounded by min(setting, time remaining) and no longer abandons a thread if the connection can be interrupted; if it cannot, say so in the pull request and keep the behaviour. Product code and UAT share one process-group kill helper in `benchbox/utils`; scripts outside the package keep theirs unless they already import `benchbox`.

## Decision gates
A name with any caller is not removed. The heavy watchdog's kill behaviour does not change. Whether plan capture's 30-second default should also go is not decided: do not change it; raise it in the final report. The changelog entry is marked breaking and names each removed export.

## Verification rubric
Pass: references evidence per removed name in the pull request; `python -c 'import benchbox.utils'` works and the removed names are absent; plan-capture tests cover min(setting, remaining); UAT timeout tests and heavy-watchdog tests pass unchanged in behaviour; `make duplicate-check-delta` does not report a new duplicate helper; `make pr-preflight` exits 0.

## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20)
The agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. Arming: `make pr-arm` once; one more attempt only when the refusal named a cause, the agent reported it and the cause is cleared; never a third without asking; `make pr-rerun` at most once and only for a job that never ran or was cancelled by the runner, never for a test that failed. Review threads: reply, and resolve only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise the finding again. Subagents are read-only. Any limit, default, threshold or label text the owner has not already chosen is shown to the owner before it is committed. No file edit by script; use the edit tool. Do not edit a pull request description while its CI is starting; post a comment. A blocked step stops this item; no workaround. No live cloud run. Heavy work only through `make heavy-run`.
